requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer's Out Of Box Experience (OOBE) at 123.hp.com must display only one consistent product name/reference for the HP OfficeJet Pro 9010 series to avoid user confusion.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must reliably print on all current and new EM (Evaluation Media) and media types required by each market segment, meeting regional print quality and intervention specifications for the Manhattan platform.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must operate as intended when placed on uneven surfaces such as sofas, table cloths, or carpets, without input tray sensor flag breakage or related failures.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Evaluate if the printer experiences any functional failure when tilted 20 degrees left or right during printing, as per CISS product standards.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must maintain print quality and normal operation when printing while placed on a moving trolley.
